parsed.rationale_overall: System A provides more actionable, specific guidance (concrete contribution amounts, tax-advantaged account maximization, specific dollar figures tied to the user's income) and has stronger factual grounding with fewer questionable numeric claims than System B (which cites an implausible 18.5% CAGR requirement and overstates QQQ's 2022 drawdown). While System B shows slightly deeper personalization with explicit cash-flow math and a glide-path framework, System A's superior actionability and grounding across four well-rounded recommendations outweigh B's edge.
